mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id, m.login_id, m.status, m.fail_cnt, m.joined, m.last_login, m.withdrawn, d.name, d.email FROM MEMBERS m LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAILS d ON m.MEMBER_ID = d.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY m.joined DESC

SELECT m.LOGIN_ID, w.SUBJECT, CASE WHEN wm.role = 70 THEN '사장' WHEN wm.role = 50 THEN '과장' WHEN wm.role = 30 THEN '대리' WHEN wm.role = 10 THEN '사원' ELSE '기타' END AS role_name FROM WORKSPACE_MEMBERS wm JOIN WORKSPACES w ON wm.WORKSPACE_ID = w.WORKSPACE_ID JOIN MEMBERS m ON wm.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE wm.MEMBER_ID = #{member_id}

SELECT m.member_id, m.login_id, m.status, m.fail_cnt, m.joined, m.last_login, m.withdrawn, d.name, d.email FROM MEMBERS m LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAILS d ON m.member_id = d.member_id WHERE m.member_id = #{member_id}

SELECT m.member_id, m.login_id, m.status, m.joined, m.last_login, m.withdrawn, d.name, d.email FROM MEMBERS m LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAILS d ON m.member_id = d.member_id WHERE d.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.login_id LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY m.joined DESC

SELECT m.member_id, m.login_id, m.status, m.fail_cnt, m.joined, m.last_login, m.withdrawn, d.name, d.email FROM MEMBERS m LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAILS d ON m.member_id = d.member_id
AND ( d.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR d.email LIKE '%' || #{keyword} ||'%' )
AND m.status = #{status}
ORDER BY m.joined DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBERS m LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAILS d ON m.member_id = d.member_id
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SECURITY s WHERE s.member_id = m.member_id AND s.role = 'ADMIN' )
AND ( d.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.login_id LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND m.status = #{status}

SELECT m.member_id, m.login_id, m.status, m.fail_cnt, m.joined, m.last_login, m.withdrawn, d.name, d.email FROM MEMBERS m LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAILS d ON m.member_id = d.member_id
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SECURITY s WHERE s.member_id = m.member_id AND s.role = 'ADMIN' )
AND ( d.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.login_id LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND m.status = #{status}
ORDER BY m.joined DESC, m.member_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY
